collection.description: A skilled nursing mother wants to resume her workshop duties, but others assume she should remain home.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (mother), a skilled nursing (mother.mother/father), wants to resume (mother.his/her) workshop duties, but others assume (mother.he/she) should remain home.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (mother.He/She) chooses shorter shifts that suit (mother.his/her) family.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (mother.He/She) returns to full duties with breaks (mother.he/she) has arranged (mother.himself/herself).

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The workshop creates a clean, comfortable place for breaks.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A hazardous task is reassigned temporarily while (mother.he/she) chooses other meaningful work.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Coworkers realize they were making decisions for (mother.him/her).

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (relative) remains worried, and they discuss the difference between concern and control.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (apprentice), an apprentice, handles lifting while (mother.he/she) directs delicate work.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (mother.He/She) prefers independent work, and the group supports (mother.his/her) choice.
